name: section
title: Section
description: Site section layout with column rules, a heading, and an optional divider.
usage: Every site section after the hero. `SectionHeading` opens it, `SectionHeaderRule` divides the heading from the content, `lines` draws the column's edges where the base layer does not (a dark band).
avoid: Shadows or colored bands between sections

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
